name: Kevin and And
description: Kevin has an integer sequence $$$a$$$ of length $$$n$$$. At the same time, Kevin has $$$m$$$ types of magic, where the $$$i$$$-th type of magic can be represented by an integer $$$b_i$$$. Kevin can perform at most $$$k$$$ (possibly zero) magic operations. In each operation, Kevin can do the following: Choose two indices $$$i$$$ ($$$1\leq i\leq n$$$) and $$$j$$$ ($$$1\leq j\leq m$$$), and then update $$$a_i$$$ to $$$a_i\ \&\ b_j$$$. Here, $$$\&$$$ denotes the bitwise AND operation . Find the minimum possible sum of all numbers in the sequence $$$a$$$ after performing at most $$$k$$$ operations.
input_specification: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$). The description of the test cases follows. The first line of each test case contains three integers $$$n, m, k$$$ ($$$1\leq n \leq 10^5$$$, $$$1\leq m \leq 10$$$, $$$0\leq k\leq nm$$$) — the length of $$$a$$$, the number of types of magic, and the maximum number of operations. The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ ($$$0\leq a_i \lt 2^{30}$$$). The third line contains $$$m$$$ integers $$$b_1, b_2, \ldots, b_m$$$ ($$$0\leq b_i \lt 2^{30}$$$). It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$10^5$$$.
output_specification: For each test case, output one integer — the minimum possible sum of all numbers in the sequence $$$a$$$ after performing at most $$$k$$$ operations.
approach_summary: Define state dp[mask][i] capturing the subset of visited/chosen elements. Transition by iterating over valid unset bits in O(2^N × N) time.
